name: Posture shirt (Alex posture)

card.summary: An elastic corrective garment designed to pull the shoulders back, aiming for a straighter, more upright stance that reads as taller and more confident.
card.note: Trials are small; one acute trial found no change from the corrective shirt.

quick.overview:
A posture shirt is a fitted garment with elastic or tie-rod elements built in to cue the shoulders and upper back toward a more upright position. People use them to reduce rounded shoulders and forward head posture, which can make someone look shorter and less confident.

Studies are small. A 4-week study of 96 computer users using one brand reported better forward shoulder and head posture, while a laboratory trial of 24 students found no immediate change with the corrective shirt compared with a sham.
quick.how: The shirt is worn under or over clothing for part of the day. In the 4-week computer-user study participants kept a log of wear time. One Parkinson's study identified about 8 hours daily as the point where the effect correlated best.
quick.risks: Wearing it is low-risk for most people. Posture-corrector evidence is limited and sometimes funded by manufacturers, per Wikipedia, and some devices may harm users.

lead: A posture shirt is a corrective garment with elastic panels intended to hold the shoulders and upper back in a straighter alignment. Rounded shoulders and a forward head position make a person look shorter and slouched, so wearers use shirts hoping to look more upright [1][3].

Research is small and mixed. A 4-week study of 96 computer users wearing AlignMed's Posture Shirt reported significant improvements in forward shoulder and head posture and thoracic kyphosis [3]. A laboratory study of 24 students found no immediate change with the corrective shirt [1].

chain: More upright shoulders and head position
angle.text: The shirt aims to reduce rounded-shoulder and forward-head posture while worn, so the wearer looks more upright. Carry-over after removal is what longer trials examine.

infobox: Elastic or tie-rod cueing of trunk and shoulders

paras: Posture correctors include braces, restrictive clothing and electronic reminder devices; Wikipedia says some are framed by sellers as reminders rather than treatments [4]. Posture shirts fall in the clothing category.

In 24 asymptomatic college students, an acute trial measured forward shoulder angle and forward head angle by photograph: the sham shirt showed a decrease relative to control, but the corrective shirt did not [1].

In 96 computer users wearing the AlignMed Posture Shirt for 4 weeks, forward shoulder and head posture, thoracic kyphosis and grip strength improved significantly, spirometry changes were not statistically significant, and reported postural and muscular fatigue decreased by 21% and 29% [3].
In 20 people with Parkinson's disease, a month of wearing a posture shirt symmetrized foot loading and enlarged foot contact area, improving balance [2].
Wikipedia states that scientific evidence for posture correctors is limited, that some studies are manufacturer-funded, and that little evidence links slouching with back pain [4].
